note: Multivariate factor betas (market, growth, size, rates, dollar, oil, crypto), orthogonalized so each beta is the MARGINAL exposure — not the double-counted univariate kind. A risk/exposure lens, not a signal; trust the portfolio aggregate, not any single stock's secondary beta.

factors.label: Market
factors.note: S&P 500 (SPY) — broad beta, the dominant risk.

factors.label: Growth / Tech
factors.note: Nasdaq-100 (QQQ) beyond market — long-duration / tech tilt.

factors.label: Small-cap
factors.note: Russell 2000 (IWM) beyond market — small-cap / domestic-cyclical tilt.

factors.label: Rates (duration)
factors.note: 20y+ Treasuries (TLT) — rises when long yields fall; + beta = bond-like / long-duration.

factors.label: US Dollar
factors.note: Dollar index (DXY) — + beta = benefits from a stronger dollar (rare for equities).

factors.label: Oil / energy
factors.note: WTI crude (26y daily) — + beta = energy / inflation-shock exposure.

factors.label: China
factors.note: FXI (China large-cap, US-hours) beyond global beta — China/HK growth exposure.
